I implemented `format_value`, `format_result`, `run_repl` and `main` in `minidb/cli.py`, and all 13 tests in `tests/test_cli.py` pass. I did not run the integration tests.

One behaviour to know about: if input stops at a `.exit` line, any partly typed statement still in the buffer is dropped rather than run. The leftover buffer only runs when input ends at EOF. The spec says `.exit` "stops processing" and the tests don't cover this case, so I left it that way.
